rules.statement: gpio has a single alert, fatal_fault, which is sent through an alert sender.

rules.condition: For each alert handshake detected by the receiver
rules.statement: o_alert is the alert_o output of the alert receiver and is 1 for exactly one clock cycle for each detected alert handshake.
o_alert_integ_fail is the integ_fail_o output of the alert receiver.
A correct alert sender never makes o_alert_integ_fail 1.
After a bus integrity fault, the fatal alert is repeated so o_alert pulses repeatedly until rst_ni is asserted.
A write of 1 to ALERT_TEST.fatal_fault triggers exactly one alert event.
